summary: AI-powered web scraping and browser automation tools have rapidly matured in 2025-2026, with LLM-native APIs, natural language extraction, and autonomous agent capabilities becoming standard differentiators. The market has stratified into three tiers: AI-native developer APIs (Firecrawl, ScrapeGraphAI), full-stack managed platforms (Apify, Bright Data, Zyte), and browser automation runtimes with AI layering (Browserbase, AgentQL, Playwright). Developer adoption is increasingly driven by LLM pipeline compatibility, clean markdown/JSON output, and managed cloud infrastructure that eliminates proxy and anti-bot management overhead.
